after Franz Kafka · 1917

An Imperial Message

A dying Emperor has sent a message. It is meant for one person only, and that person is you.


Text-only version · about ten minutes · the name stays on this device

With gratitude

The idea of making this game came to me from the teaching of Prof. (Dr.) Prasannanshu, who asks his students to be creative, and to answer a work of literature by making something of their own.

Vikas Goyanka · LLB26057 · National Law University, Delhi
